A clear data boundary

Your inputs stay with you.

Calculators, tool shortlists, and brief preparation run locally in this website.

Local interactions

Calculator inputs run in the browser. Shortlists stay in page memory. Briefs and worksheets download or copy on your device. These inputs are not submitted to a CRM, email destination, AI provider, or server, and are not persisted in cookies or local storage.

External resources

Google Fonts and cited remote brand images may request assets from their hosts. Embedded logos load locally. External links open provider sites under their own terms. Railway serves this website and may retain ordinary hosting request logs.

Contact and analytics

The project page prepares a downloadable brief. It does not send an enquiry; a receiving email, CRM, or booking destination has not been configured. No advertising pixel or analytics integration is included. Before connecting those services, define the resulting data flows and update this notice.
